complexity.notes: This computes correct results but sidesteps the problem entirely: the statement forbids built-in library functions, and the intended exercise is implementing ||binary exponentiation (repeated squaring)|| yourself in O(log n). CPython evaluates float**int via C library pow, which is why this is O(1) here; on an int base with a large exponent the same operator would do O(log n) big-integer multiplications.
complexity.summary: Returns x**n in one line, delegating everything to Python's built-in exponentiation operator on floats.
